justification: Critical: registers two council DCP chapters and loads 31 building-area controls (migrations 103, 104, applied) that the buildable-area arithmetic serves; the generator now reads council PDFs directly.

pre_impl.existing_data: DQ-142 read 33. Sutherland had no residential DCP chapter registered; Cumberland Part B defers dual occupancy to the Low Rise Housing Diversity Design Guide.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Sutherland sets controls per zone, so one council-wide row per control would be wrong; its 50% deep soil applies to the front setback area only, not the lot.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Same generator as migrations 092/095; adds zone-specific rows (applicability zone_specific + zones_include) and reading a chapter's official PDF when no mirrored copy exists.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Every quote is checked on its page of the council's own PDF (fetched through curl when Cloudflare challenges Python), and every figure and unit in its quote.
pre_impl.frontend_type: No frontend change; the arithmetic reads the same dcp_setback_controls columns, now with zone-specific rows for Sutherland.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Without these rows the buildable-area figure is withheld for Sutherland; a council-wide row would serve one zone's setback to every zone.

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_dq142_build_controls_migration.py -q ; python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-142 ; python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-32b
falsifiable_check.fails_when: A quote is not on its page of the council PDF, a zone-specific rule is stored council-wide (DQ-32b), or the rows are removed (DQ-142 back to 33).
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Observed 2026-10-10: the first downloads returned a 5.7 KB Cloudflare challenge page; the generator now refuses anything that is not a PDF. Python requests got 403 even with a browser user agent; curl fallback added. The reader's 14 deep-soil rows were dropped (front-setback area only). 31 verified, 0 refused; DQ-142 33 -> 26; DQ-32b 0.

functions.name: pdf_page_text
functions.input: a council slug, a registered chapter key and a one-based page number from a reader finding
functions.output: that page's normalised text, from the mirrored PDF or else the council's official PDF
functions.if_none: None when the chapter has no PDF or the page is out of range; a non-PDF response raises rather than verifying against it.

values.value: 31 building-area controls (Sutherland per-zone setbacks; Cumberland deferral to the design guide)
values.source: Sutherland Shire DCP 2015 Ch 2 and Ch 4 (May 2026); Cumberland DCP Part B
values.if_missing: The footprint is withheld; no figure is invented.

break_it.scenario: A council site serves a bot-challenge page instead of the PDF
break_it.what_happens: The generator refuses to verify against it and stops with a named error

break_it.scenario: A per-zone setback is stored without its zone and served everywhere
break_it.what_happens: Prevented: rows carrying a zone are zone_specific with zones_include set

break_it.scenario: A deep-soil figure that applies only to the front setback is used as a whole-lot cap
break_it.what_happens: Prevented here: those 14 rows were dropped before generation
break_it.how: main-session review of the reader output

break_it.scenario: A quote was paraphrased or copied from a different page of the PDF
break_it.what_happens: The finding is refused and named; no SQL row is written for it
break_it.how: normalised substring check on the named page

break_it.scenario: A figure appears only inside a larger number or with the wrong unit
break_it.what_happens: Refused by the whole-number and unit check, so no row is written

break_it.scenario: The chapter PDF location in the registry is missing or points to a page that is not the chapter
break_it.what_happens: With no URL every quote is refused; a non-PDF response stops the run; a wrong document fails the quote-on-page check
break_it.how: COALESCE(r2_public_pdf_url, council_url) + %PDF check + per-page quote match

post_merge.manual_verify: Migrations 103 and 104 are applied: python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-142 reads 26.
